title: IndustriAll Europe union protest at European Parliament in Strasbourg

tea.why: Metal and textile workers protested to defend jobs and express concerns over industry shifts, high energy costs, and foreign competition.
tea.want: Favorable conditions in the upcoming Industrial Accelerator Act to protect and revive continental industry.
tea.changed: Nov 24: IndustriAll Europe organized a demonstration of workers outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg.

summary: On November 24, 2026, metal and textile workers gathered outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg for a major mobilization organized by IndustriAll Europe. Protesters from various regions and companies, including metal and chemical union members, traveled by bus to voice concerns over job security, redundancies, lay-offs, temporary layoff schemes, high electricity costs, and competition from Chinese manufacturers. The demonstration took place ahead of the finalization of the Industrial Accelerator Act regulation, with participants demanding favorable conditions and safeguards to protect European industrial sectors.
demands: Include favorable conditions in the Industrial Accelerator Act to protect and revive European industry
Defend manufacturing jobs against foreign competition and shifts toward the defense sector
Address workforce reductions and frequent reliance on layoff schemes
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: IndustriAll Europe organized a protest outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg.
